## Description

Applies fractional integration parameters ($d$) to Vector Error Correction Models to capture persistent long-memory mean-reversion in multi-asset cointegrated baskets.

## Where it may fit

Cointegrated sector baskets, multi-asset statistical arbitrage with slow mean-reversion persistence.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Funds, Quantitative Equity Market-Neutral Desks.

## Required data

Historical price series of paired or basket assets, fractional differencing parameters.

## Caveats

Accurate estimation of fractional memory parameter $d$ requires sufficient historical depth.
